name: session-journal
description: Record Claude Code and Codex sessions to an Obsidian vault (or a subfolder of an existing one): one daily journal note (Journal/<date>.md) with a chronological summary block per MEANINGFUL session (throwaway sessions skipped, no verbatim transcript, no auto-generated wiki). The bulky raw event log lives OUTSIDE the vault (under $XDG_STATE_HOME/session-journal) with retention. Every note is tagged #ai-generated to stay distinct from hand-authored notes. Portable name-based vault resolution (with an explicit-pin guard against duplicate same-named vaults) for multi-machine setups synced via Obsidian Sync.
